security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Themed CDG+MP3 and LRC karaoke player
bundle.longDescription: A themed karaoke player supporting CDG+MP3 and LRC formats, with real-time microphone pitch detection and singing scores. Your song library stays on your device.
